proof_scope: Tau DAG timeline viewer hardening smoke and adversarial regression coverage

claims.proves: the declared Tau timeline viewer commands meet explicit local expectations across repeated trials, including one live browser proof path
claims.does_not_prove: full Tau immutable-goal completion, provider/model quality, all viewport sizes, all ledger shapes, or production release readiness

cases.name: live-browser-timeline-layout-proof
command: cd .. && out_dir="/tmp/tau-agentic-evals-dag-viewer-${RANDOM}-$(date +%s%N)" && mkdir -p "$out_dir" && CHROME_BIN=/usr/bin/google-chrome uv run python scripts/run-dag-viewer-browser-proof.py --out "$out_dir/browser-proof.json" --screenshot "$out_dir/browser-proof.png" --run-root "$out_dir/run" && jq -e '.status == "PASS" and .mocked == false and .live == true and .provider_live == false and ([.checks[]] | all(. == true))' "$out_dir/browser-proof.json"

cases.name: adversarial-admission-execution-separation
command: cd .. && npm --prefix web/dag-viewer test -- --run src/tests/App.timeline.test.tsx -t 'timeline proof clips do not turn accepted from execution state alone|timeline execution ignores proof admission and failure takes precedence|timeline execution cannot be accepted by admission alone'

cases.name: adversarial-colliding-node-selector-uniqueness
command: cd .. && npm --prefix web/dag-viewer test -- --run src/tests/App.timeline.test.tsx -t 'timeline selectors remain unique when node ids sanitize to the same qid token'

capability_claims.description: Tau DAG viewer timeline renders a live browser proof path and preserves admission/execution separation plus selector uniqueness under adversarial cases.
